realReviews.author: Carolyn Hoogervorst
realReviews.text:
Josh had been working at a neighbour’s home and had done a great job, the neighbours being very pleased with his work.

I asked Josh if he would be interested in renovating my back deck.

Josh had excellent ideas and suggestions and so the process began. He was always on time, communicated well, was efficient, very neat and tidy with an eye for detail and keen to deliver a quality product! He worked with Dave (also a carpenter) and their fine tuning to the last mm was very professional!

I cannot tell you how thrilled I am with my new back deck and would highly recommend Sunnyside Carpentry if you are looking for a meticulous new look/renovation!

Carolyn

realReviews.author: Jodie Franken
realReviews.text:
First impressions DO matter! my outdated entry way needed a facelift and how beautifully it has been revived with this stunning eko deck walkway!

Josh was absolutely incredible throughout the whole process from quoting and advice to the efficiency and installation!

This project was done within great time and workmanship was neat and tidy each step of the way. The care and attention to detail is evident in the final outcome!

I could not be happier with my fresh entrance and cannot wait to have them back to bring my back verandah up to the same standard!

realReviews.author: Matt Rumsey
realReviews.text: Josh from Sunnyside Carpentry Coffs was excellent for our shed framing job. He helped create exactly what we envisioned and was a great communicator throughout. Josh was efficient, detailed and precise in this build, and this allowed me to continue the progress of the build smoothly with other contractors. For any future building and carpentry needs, I would highly recommend Josh and the team from Sunnyside Carpentry Coffs
